summary: Conviction under IPC s.302; prosecution case based on circumstantial evidence, minor eyewitness (daughter), discovery of weapon under Evidence Act s.27; analysis of s.106 (burden of proof), 'prima facie case' standard; admissibility of discovery; hostile witness cross-examination; claim of Exception 4 to s.300 IPC (grave and sudden provocation) examined; High Court affirmed conviction; appeal challenging evidentiary weight and legal standards.
